description: Source and event evidence inventory for Bengaluru flood research. Narrative references are not model labels unless evaluation_eligible is true.

sources.title: Situation Report 1: Floods in Bengaluru
sources.source_basis: The report says its Bengaluru situation information was received from SEOC Karnataka and lists IMD, CWC, MHA and news media among its information sources.
sources.reuse_status: The report does not state an open data licence. This manifest stores bibliographic metadata and a short factual summary only; do not redistribute the report or treat the source as permission to reuse underlying records.

sources.title: Flooding Locations in Bengaluru Urban
sources.publisher: OpenCity dataset catalog; listed under Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike
sources.source_basis: Catalog description identifies common flooding points in Bengaluru Urban.
sources.reuse_status: Catalog page does not establish event timestamps or an explicit record-level licence in the metadata inspected. Treat as an undated spatial prior only; never use as event ground truth.

sources.title: Near Real Time Flood Mapping and Monitoring
sources.source_basis: NRSC describes date-stamped satellite flood inundation layers arranged by year, state and date.
sources.reuse_status: NDEM portal content states it is intended for authorized users. No Bengaluru-specific downloadable event layer or reuse permission was verified for this work. Do not import portal data without access authorization and source terms.

sources.title: India Flood Inventory-Impacts (IFI-Impacts), version 3, 1967–2023
sources.publisher: HydroSense Lab, IIT Delhi; inventory events attributed to IMD
sources.source_basis: The source file is the published India_Flood_Inventory_v3.csv from Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.11275211. Its MD5 (fea75a9ff9eba8fb328eaddfacd21d67) matches the supplied source. The derived CSV selects rows whose Districts field explicitly contains Bengaluru Urban and normalizes calendar dates without treating source midnight placeholders as event times.
sources.reuse_status: The exact v3 Zenodo record declares CC BY 4.0. The derived subset is attributed to HydroSense Lab/IIT Delhi and IMD, with the source DOI, checksum, transformation and license documented in backend/data/flood_events/README.md. The later v4 record reports different terms; this project uses the exact checksum-matched v3 record only.

event_time.precision: night; exact local time unavailable in source

location.precision: zones and localities named in an aggregate situation report; locations are not individually paired with times
location.geocoding_provenance: No geometry in source; names are retained as reported and have not been geocoded.

observation.summary: Situation report describes low-lying-area inundation and waterlogging after widespread rainfall, and names several affected areas. It does not provide per-location event observations.

events.evaluation_exclusion_reason: This report is useful as a dated narrative reference only. It lacks precise per-location time and geometry, an observed street/inundation label, and matched event rainfall inputs required by the current backtest.
